mapping.author: claude-mapper-m20-9
mapping.draft_py:
# Blood Burglar: "During your turn, this creature has lifelink."
# Shape: M21 Radha, Heart of Keld's B5a-radha-first-strike ("During your turn, Radha has first
# strike.") with KeywordAbility(LIFELINK).
lifelink_your_turn = StaticAbility(
    effect=A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
        'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.LIFELINK),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
    condition=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TURN_OF, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
)
abilities = [lifelink_your_turn, *compiled]

clauses.clause: During your turn, this creature has lifelink.

mapping.notes: Radha, Heart of Keld shape (B5a-radha-first-strike) with LIFELINK. Packs: attacking on your turn gains 2; blocking on the opponent's turn gains nothing.
